verses.text: King Solomon love plenty foreign women, together with Pharaoh daughter: women from di Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians and Hittites,

from di nations wey di Lord talk about to Israel pikin dem say, “Una no go enter among dem, and dem no go enter among una, because dem go turn una heart follow dem gods.” Solomon hold on to dem for love.
E get 700 wives wey be princesses, and 300 concubines, and im wives turn im heart away.
Because e happen say as Solomon don old, im wives turn im heart follow other gods, and im heart no dey complete with di Lord im God, as im papa David heart be.
Because Solomon follow Ashtoreth, di goddess of di Sidonians, and Milcom, di disgusting god of di Ammonites.
Solomon do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, and e no follow di Lord fully, as im papa David do.
Den Solomon build high place for Chemosh, di disgusting god of Moab, for di mountain wey dey front of Jerusalem, and for Molech, di disgusting god of Ammon pikin dem.
Na so e do for all im foreign wives, wey dey burn incense and make sacrifice to dem gods.
Di Lord vex with Solomon, because im heart don turn from di Lord, di God of Israel, wey appear to am two times,
and command am about dis thing say make e no follow other gods, but e no keep wetin di Lord command.
So di Lord talk to Solomon say, “Because you do dis thing, and you no keep my covenant and my laws wey I command you, I go tear di kingdom from you for sure and give am to your servant.
But I no go do am for your days, because of your papa David, but I go tear am from your pikin hand.
Still, I no go tear all di kingdom away, but I go give one tribe to your pikin, because of David my servant and because of Jerusalem wey I choose.”
Di Lord raise enemy against Solomon, Hadad di Edomite. E be from di king family for Edom.
Because e happen say as David dey Edom, and Joab di captain of di army go up to bury di dead, e kill every man for Edom.
Because Joab and all Israel stay there six months, until e cut off every man for Edom.
Hadad run, e and some Edomites wey be im papa servants dey with am, to go Egypt, and Hadad still be small pikin.
Dem comot from Midian and come reach Paran. Dem take men from Paran follow dem, and dem reach Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt. E give am house, arrange food for am and give am land.
Hadad find big favor before Pharaoh, so tay e give am im own wife sister as wife, di sister of Tahpenes di queen.
Tahpenes sister born Genubath im pikin for am. Tahpenes raise am for Pharaoh house, and Genubath dey Pharaoh house among Pharaoh pikin dem.
As Hadad hear for Egypt say David don die join im papa dem, and say Joab di captain of di army don die, Hadad talk to Pharaoh say, “Make I go, so that I go reach my own country.”
Den Pharaoh talk to am say, “But wetin you lack with me, say look, you wan go your own country?” E answer say, “Nothing, but make you just let me go.”
God raise another enemy for am, Rezon, Eliada pikin, wey run from im oga Hadadezer, king of Zobah.
E gather men to am and become captain over one group, as David kill dem for Zobah. Dem go Damascus, stay there and rule for Damascus.
E be enemy to Israel all di days of Solomon, apart from di trouble wey Hadad do. E hate Israel and rule over Syria.
Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, one Ephraim man from Zeredah, Solomon servant, im mama name na Zeruah, one widow, e too lift im hand against di king.
Na dis be di reason why e lift im hand against di king: Solomon build Millo and repair di broken part of im papa David city.
Di man Jeroboam be strong and brave man, and Solomon see say di young man dey work hard, and e put am in charge of all di labor of Joseph house.
E happen for dat time, as Jeroboam go out from Jerusalem, say Ahijah di prophet from Shiloh meet am for road. Ahijah don wear new cloth, and di two of dem dey alone for di field.
Ahijah hold di new cloth wey dey on am and tear am into 12 pieces.
E talk to Jeroboam say, “Take ten pieces for yourself, because dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: ‘Look, I go tear di kingdom from Solomon hand and give you ten tribes,
but e go get one tribe, because of my servant David and because of Jerusalem, di city wey I choose from all di tribes of Israel,

because dem don leave me, and worship Ashtoreth di goddess of di Sidonians, Chemosh di god of Moab, and Milcom di god of Ammon pikin dem, and dem no waka for my ways, to do wetin good for my eyes, and to keep my laws and my rules, as im papa David do.
Still, I no go take all di kingdom from im hand, but I go make am ruler all di days of im life, because of David my servant wey I choose, wey keep my commands and my laws,
but I go take di kingdom from im pikin hand and give am to you, ten tribes.
To im pikin I go give one tribe, so that David my servant go always get lamp before me for Jerusalem, di city wey I choose to put my name there.
I go take you, and you go rule as all wey your soul want, and you go be king over Israel.

E go happen say if you listen to all wey I command you, and waka for my ways, and do wetin good for my eyes, to keep my laws and my commands, as David my servant do, I go dey with you and I go build strong house for you, as I build for David, and I go give you Israel.
Because of dis I go punish David pikin dem, but no be forever.’”
So Solomon try to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam stand up and run go Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and e dey Egypt until Solomon die.
Di rest of wetin Solomon do, and all wey e do, and im wisdom, dem no write dem for di book of di acts of Solomon?
Di time wey Solomon rule for Jerusalem over all Israel na 40 years.
Solomon die join im papa dem, and dem bury am for im papa David city, and im pikin Rehoboam rule for im place.
Rehoboam go Shechem, because all Israel don come to Shechem to make am king.
E happen say as Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, hear am, e still dey Egypt, wia e run go from King Solomon face, and Jeroboam dey stay for Egypt,
dem send call am. Jeroboam and all di people of Israel come and talk to Rehoboam say,
“Your papa make our yoke heavy. So now make your papa hard work and im heavy yoke wey e put on us light small, and we go serve you.”
E talk to dem say, “Go for three days, den come back to me.” Di people go.
King Rehoboam ask di old men wey dey stand before im papa Solomon as e still dey alive for advice, say, “How una take advise me to answer dis people?”
Dem talk to am say, “If you go be servant to dis people today, and serve dem, and answer dem and talk good words to dem, den dem go be your servants forever.”
But e leave di advice of di old men wey dem give am, and ask di young men wey grow up with am, wey dey stand before am.
E talk to dem say, “Wetin una advise say make we answer dis people wey talk to me say, ‘Make di yoke wey your papa put on us light small’?”

Di young men wey grow up with am talk to am say, “Na so you go tell dis people wey talk to you say, ‘Your papa make our yoke heavy, but make am light for us.’ Na so you go tell dem, ‘My small finger thick pass my papa waist.
Now as my papa put heavy yoke on una, I go add to una yoke. My papa beat una with whips, but I go beat una with scorpions.’”
So Jeroboam and all di people come to Rehoboam di third day, as di king talk say, “Come back to me di third day.”
Di king answer di people hard, and e leave di advice of di old men wey dem give am,
and talk to dem as di advice of di young men be, say, “My papa make una yoke heavy, but I go add to una yoke. My papa beat una with whips, but I go beat una with scorpions.”
So di king no listen to di people, because na di Lord arrange am, so that e go make im word stand, wey di Lord talk by Ahijah from Shiloh to Jeroboam, Nebat pikin.

As all Israel see say di king no listen to dem, di people answer di king say, “Wetin be our share for David? We no get inheritance for Jesse pikin. Go your tents, Israel! Now look after your own house, David.” So Israel go dem tents.
But as for Israel pikin dem wey dey stay for Judah cities, Rehoboam rule over dem.
Den King Rehoboam send Adoram, wey dey over di men wey dey do forced work, and all Israel stone am to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurry climb im chariot to run go Jerusalem.
So Israel rebel against David house till today.
E happen say as all Israel hear say Jeroboam don come back, dem send call am come di gathering and make am king over all Israel. Nobody follow David house except Judah tribe only.
As Rehoboam reach Jerusalem, e gather all Judah house and Benjamin tribe, 180,000 chosen men wey be warriors, to fight against Israel house, to bring di kingdom back to Rehoboam, Solomon pikin.
But di word of God come to Shemaiah, di man of God, say,
“Talk to Rehoboam, Solomon pikin, king of Judah, and to all Judah and Benjamin house, and to di rest of di people say,

‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “Una no go go up or fight against una brothers, Israel pikin dem. Make every man return to im house, because dis thing na from me.”’” So dem listen to di word of di Lord, and return go dem way, as di word of di Lord talk.
Den Jeroboam build Shechem for Ephraim hill country and stay there, and e go out from there and build Penuel.
Jeroboam talk for im heart say, “Now di kingdom go return to David house.

If dis people go up to make sacrifice for di Lord house for Jerusalem, den dis people heart go turn back to dem oga, to Rehoboam king of Judah, and dem go kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”
So di king ask for advice and make two calves of gold, and e talk to di people say, “E too much for una to go up to Jerusalem. Look, your gods, Israel, wey bring una comot from Egypt land.”
E set one for Bethel, and di other one e put for Dan.
Dis thing become sin, because di people go worship before one of dem, even reach Dan.
E make houses for high places, and make priests from among all di people, wey no be from Levi pikin dem.

Jeroboam set one feast for di eighth month, for di 15th day of di month, like di feast wey dey Judah, and e go up to di altar. Na so e do for Bethel, dey make sacrifice to di calves wey e make, and e put for Bethel di priests of di high places wey e make.
E go up to di altar wey e make for Bethel for di 15th day of di eighth month, di month wey e think up from im own heart, and e set feast for Israel pikin dem, and go up to di altar to burn incense.
Look, one man of God come from Judah by di word of di Lord go Bethel, and Jeroboam dey stand by di altar to burn incense.

E cry out against di altar by di word of di Lord and talk say, “Altar, altar, dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Look, dem go born one pikin for David house, im name na Josiah. And on you e go sacrifice di priests of di high places wey dey burn incense on you, and dem go burn men bones on you.’”
E give sign di same day say, “Dis na di sign wey di Lord don talk: Look, di altar go split open, and di ashes wey dey on am go pour out.”

E happen say as di king hear wetin di man of God cry out against di altar for Bethel, Jeroboam stretch out im hand from di altar say, “Catch am!” Im hand wey e stretch out against am dry up, so tay e no fit pull am back again.
Di altar split open too, and di ashes pour out from di altar, as di sign wey di man of God give by di word of di Lord be.
Di king answer di man of God say, “Now beg di Lord your God and pray for me, make my hand come back to me.” Di man of God beg di Lord, and di king hand come back to am and become as e be before.
Di king talk to di man of God say, “Come my house with me and rest, and I go give you gift.”
Di man of God talk to di king say, “If you give me half of your house, I no go enter with you, and I no go eat bread or drink water for dis place,
because na so dem command me by di word of di Lord, say, ‘You no go eat bread or drink water, and you no go return by di way wey you come.’”
So e go another way, and e no return by di way wey e take come Bethel.
One old prophet dey stay for Bethel, and one of im pikin come tell am all di things wey di man of God do dat day for Bethel. Di words wey e talk to di king too, dem tell dem papa.
Dem papa talk to dem say, “Which way e take go?” Im pikin dem don see di way wey di man of God wey come from Judah take go.
E talk to im pikin dem say, “Put saddle on di donkey for me.” So dem put saddle on di donkey for am, and e ride am.
E follow di man of God and find am dey sit under one oak tree. E talk to am say, “Na you be di man of God wey come from Judah?” E answer say, “Na me.”
Den e talk to am say, “Come my house with me and eat bread.”
E talk say, “I no fit return with you or enter with you, and I no go eat bread or drink water with you for dis place.
Because dem talk to me by di word of di Lord say, ‘You no go eat bread or drink water there, or turn back to go by di way wey you come.’”
E talk to am say, “I too na prophet like you, and angel talk to me by di word of di Lord say, ‘Bring am back with you enter your house, so that e go eat bread and drink water.’” E lie to am.
So e go back with am and eat bread for im house and drink water.
E happen say as dem dey sit for di table, di word of di Lord come to di prophet wey bring am back,
and e cry out to di man of God wey come from Judah say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Because you no obey di mouth of di Lord, and you no keep di command wey di Lord your God command you,
but you come back, and you don eat bread and drink water for di place wey e talk to you about say, “No eat bread and no drink water,” your body no go reach di grave of your papa dem.’”
E happen say after e don eat bread and drink, e put saddle on di donkey for am, for di prophet wey e bring back.
As e go, one lion meet am for road and kill am, and dem throw im body for road, and di donkey stand by am. Di lion stand by di body too.
Look, men pass and see di body wey dem throw for road, and di lion wey dey stand by di body, and dem come tell am for di city wia di old prophet dey stay.

As di prophet wey bring am back from di way hear am, e talk say, “Na di man of God be dat, wey no obey di mouth of di Lord. So di Lord don give am to di lion, wey don tear am and kill am, as di word of di Lord wey e talk to am be.”
E talk to im pikin dem say, “Put saddle on di donkey for me.” Dem put saddle on am.
E go and find im body wey dem throw for road, and di donkey and di lion dey stand by di body. Di lion no eat di body or tear di donkey.
Di prophet carry di body of di man of God, put am on di donkey, and bring am back. E come di city of di old prophet to cry for am and to bury am.
E put im body for im own grave, and dem cry for am say, “Ah, my brother!”
E happen say after e don bury am, e talk to im pikin dem say, “As I don die, bury me for di grave wia dem bury di man of God. Put my bones beside im bones.
Because di word wey e cry out by di word of di Lord against di altar for Bethel, and against all di houses of di high places wey dey Samaria cities, go happen for sure.”

After dis thing Jeroboam no return from im evil way, but e make priests of di high places again from among all di people. Anybody wey want, e go make am priest, so that e go get priests of di high places.
Dis thing become sin to Jeroboam house, to cut am off and destroy am from di face of di earth.
For dat time Abijah, Jeroboam pikin, fall sick.

Jeroboam talk to im wife say, “Stand up, change your appearance, so that dem no go know say na Jeroboam wife you be, and go Shiloh. Look, Ahijah di prophet dey there, wey tell me say I go be king over dis people.
Take ten loaves with you, and some cakes, and one jar of honey, and go meet am. E go tell you wetin go happen to di pikin.”
Jeroboam wife do so, stand up and go Shiloh and reach Ahijah house. Ahijah no fit see, because im eyes don dull because of old age.
Di Lord talk to Ahijah say, “Look, Jeroboam wife dey come to ask you about im pikin, because e dey sick. Na so and so you go talk to am, because as e enter, e go pretend say na another woman e be.”
E happen say as Ahijah hear di sound of im feet as e enter di door, e talk say, “Enter, Jeroboam wife. Why you dey pretend say you be another person? Because dem send me to you with heavy news.
Go tell Jeroboam, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: “Because I lift you up from among di people, and make you ruler over my people Israel,
and tear di kingdom from David house and give am to you, but you no be like my servant David, wey keep my commands, and wey follow me with all im heart, to do only wetin good for my eyes,
but you don do evil pass all di ones wey dey before you, and you don go make other gods for yourself, and idols wey dem melt, to make me vex, and you don throw me behind your back,

so look, I go bring evil on Jeroboam house, and I go cut off from Jeroboam every male, di one wey dem lock up and di one wey dey free for Israel, and I go sweep Jeroboam house away completely, as man dey sweep dirt away, until e finish.
Anybody for Jeroboam family wey die for di city, dogs go eat am, and anybody wey die for di field, birds of di sky go eat am, because di Lord don talk am.”’
So stand up, go your house. As your feet enter di city, di pikin go die.
All Israel go cry for am and bury am, because na only am for Jeroboam family go enter di grave, because dem find some good thing for am toward di Lord, di God of Israel, for Jeroboam house.
Di Lord go raise one king for Israel, wey go cut off Jeroboam house dat day. But wetin I dey talk? Even now.

Because di Lord go strike Israel, as dem dey shake reed for water, and e go uproot Israel from dis good land wey e give dem papa dem, and e go scatter dem cross di River, because dem make dem Asherah poles, dey make di Lord vex.
E go give Israel up because of di sins of Jeroboam, wey sin and wey make Israel sin.”
Jeroboam wife stand up and go, and reach Tirzah, and as e reach di door of di house, di pikin die.
All Israel bury am and cry for am, as di word of di Lord wey e talk by im servant Ahijah di prophet be.
Di rest of wetin Jeroboam do, how e fight and how e rule, look, dem write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel.
Di days wey Jeroboam rule na 22 years, and e die join im papa dem, and im pikin Nadab rule for im place.

Rehoboam, Solomon pikin, rule for Judah. Rehoboam be 41 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 17 years for Jerusalem, di city wey di Lord choose from all di tribes of Israel to put im name there. Im mama name na Naamah, one Ammon woman.
Judah do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, and dem make am jealous with dem sins wey dem do, pass all wey dem papa dem do.
Because dem build high places for demselves too, and pillars, and Asherah poles, for every high hill and under every green tree.
Men wey dey sell dem body for idol worship dey di land too. Dem do all di wicked things of di nations wey di Lord drive out before Israel pikin dem.
E happen for di fifth year of King Rehoboam say Shishak king of Egypt come up against Jerusalem,
and e carry away di treasures of di Lord house and di treasures of di king house. E carry everything, and e carry all di gold shields wey Solomon make.
King Rehoboam make bronze shields for dem place and give dem to di captains of di guard, wey dey guard di door of di king house.
E happen say any time di king go enter di Lord house, di guards go carry dem and bring dem back enter di guard room.
Di rest of wetin Rehoboam do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
War dey between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all di time.
Rehoboam die join im papa dem and dem bury am with im papa dem for David city. Im mama name na Naamah, one Ammon woman. Im pikin Abijam rule for im place.
For di 18th year of King Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, Abijam begin to rule over Judah.
E rule three years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Maacah, Abishalom pikin.
E waka for all di sins of im papa wey e do before am, and im heart no dey complete with di Lord im God, as im papa David heart be.
Still, because of David, di Lord im God give am lamp for Jerusalem, to set up im pikin after am and to make Jerusalem stand strong,
because David do wetin good for di Lord eyes, and e no turn aside from anything wey e command am all di days of im life, except only for di matter of Uriah di Hittite.
War dey between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all di days of im life.
Di rest of wetin Abijam do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah? War dey between Abijam and Jeroboam.
Abijam die join im papa dem and dem bury am for David city, and im pikin Asa rule for im place.
For di 20th year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa begin to rule over Judah.
E rule 41 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Maacah, Abishalom pikin.
Asa do wetin good for di Lord eyes, as im papa David do.
E remove di men wey dey sell dem body for idol worship from di land, and e remove all di idols wey im papa dem make.
E remove Maacah im mama from to be queen mother too, because e make one disgusting image for Asherah. Asa cut down im image and burn am for Kidron stream.
But dem no remove di high places. Still, Asa heart dey complete with di Lord all im days.
E bring enter di Lord house di things wey im papa don give to God, and di things wey e imself give to God, silver, and gold, and things.
War dey between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all dem days.
Baasha king of Israel go up against Judah and build Ramah, so that nobody go fit go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

Den Asa take all di silver and di gold wey remain for di treasures of di Lord house and di treasures of di king house and give dem to im servants. King Asa send dem to Ben Hadad, Tabrimmon pikin, Hezion pikin, king of Syria, wey dey stay for Damascus, say,
“Treaty dey between me and you, between my papa and your papa. Look, I don send gift of silver and gold to you. Go break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that e go leave me.”
Ben Hadad listen to King Asa and send di captains of im armies against di cities of Israel, and e strike Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all Naphtali land.
E happen say as Baasha hear am, e stop to build Ramah and dey stay for Tirzah.
Den King Asa make announcement to all Judah, nobody escape. Dem carry away di stones of Ramah and di wood wey Baasha use build, and King Asa use dem build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

Di rest of all wetin Asa do, and all im power, and all wey e do, and di cities wey e build, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah? But for di time of im old age, sickness dey im feet.
Asa die join im papa dem and dem bury am with im papa dem for im papa David city, and im pikin Jehoshaphat rule for im place.
Nadab, Jeroboam pikin, begin to rule over Israel for di second year of Asa king of Judah, and e rule over Israel two years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, and e waka for im papa way, and for im sin wey e use make Israel sin.
Baasha, Ahijah pikin, from Issachar house, plan against am, and Baasha strike am for Gibbethon, wey belong to di Philistines, because Nadab and all Israel dey surround Gibbethon.
Even for di third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha kill am and rule for im place.
E happen say as e become king, e strike all Jeroboam house. E no leave anybody wey dey breathe for Jeroboam until e don destroy am, as di word of di Lord wey e talk by im servant Ahijah from Shiloh,
because of di sins of Jeroboam wey e sin, and wey e use make Israel sin, because of how e make di Lord, di God of Israel, vex.
Di rest of wetin Nadab do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
War dey between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all dem days.
For di third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha, Ahijah pikin, begin to rule over all Israel for Tirzah, and e rule 24 years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, and e waka for Jeroboam way and for im sin wey e use make Israel sin.
Di word of di Lord come to Jehu, Hanani pikin, against Baasha, say,
“Because I lift you up from di dust and make you ruler over my people Israel, and you waka for Jeroboam way and make my people Israel sin, to make me vex with dem sins,
look, I go sweep Baasha and im house away completely, and I go make your house like Jeroboam house, Nebat pikin.
Anybody for Baasha family wey die for di city, dogs go eat am, and anybody wey die for di field, birds of di sky go eat am.”
Di rest of wetin Baasha do, and wetin e do, and im power, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
Baasha die join im papa dem and dem bury am for Tirzah, and im pikin Elah rule for im place.

Di word of di Lord come again by Jehu di prophet, Hanani pikin, against Baasha and against im house, both because of all di evil wey e do for di Lord eyes, to make am vex with di work of im hands, as e be like Jeroboam house, and because e strike am.
For di 26th year of Asa king of Judah, Elah, Baasha pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Tirzah, and e rule two years.
Im servant Zimri, captain of half of im chariots, plan against am. As e dey Tirzah, e dey drink till e drunk for Arza house, wey dey over di house for Tirzah.
Zimri enter, strike am and kill am, for di 27th year of Asa king of Judah, and e rule for im place.
E happen say as e begin to rule, as e sit for im throne, e strike all Baasha house. E no leave even one man for am, no im relatives, no im friends.
Na so Zimri destroy all Baasha house, as di word of di Lord wey e talk against Baasha by Jehu di prophet be,
because of all di sins of Baasha and di sins of Elah im pikin, wey dem sin and wey dem use make Israel sin, to make di Lord, di God of Israel, vex with dem useless idols.
Di rest of wetin Elah do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
For di 27th year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri rule seven days for Tirzah. Di people dey camp against Gibbethon, wey belong to di Philistines.
Di people wey dey camp hear say, “Zimri don plan against di king and don kill am too.” So all Israel make Omri, di captain of di army, king over Israel dat day for di camp.
Omri go up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with am, and dem surround Tirzah.
E happen say as Zimri see say dem don take di city, e enter di strong part of di king house and burn di king house over imself with fire, and e die,
because of im sins wey e sin, as e do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, as e waka for Jeroboam way and for im sin wey e do, to make Israel sin.
Di rest of wetin Zimri do, and im treason wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
Den di people of Israel divide into two parts. Half of di people follow Tibni, Ginath pikin, to make am king, and half follow Omri.
But di people wey follow Omri win di people wey follow Tibni, Ginath pikin. So Tibni die, and Omri rule.
For di 31st year of Asa king of Judah, Omri begin to rule over Israel, and e rule 12 years. Six years e rule for Tirzah.
E buy di hill Samaria from Shemer with two talents of silver, and e build for di hill, and call di city wey e build Samaria, after di name of Shemer, di owner of di hill.
Omri do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, and e do wickedness pass all wey dey before am.
Because e waka for all di way of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, and for im sins wey e use make Israel sin, to make di Lord, di God of Israel, vex with dem useless idols.
Di rest of wetin Omri do, and im power wey e show, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
So Omri die join im papa dem and dem bury am for Samaria, and im pikin Ahab rule for im place.
For di 38th year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab, Omri pikin, begin to rule over Israel, and Ahab, Omri pikin, rule over Israel for Samaria 22 years.
Ahab, Omri pikin, do wetin bad for di Lord eyes pass all wey dey before am.
E happen say as if na small thing for am to waka for di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, e marry Jezebel, Ethbaal pikin, king of di Sidonians, and go serve Baal and worship am.
E set up altar for Baal for Baal house, wey e build for Samaria.
Ahab make di Asherah pole, and Ahab do more to make di Lord, di God of Israel, vex pass all di kings of Israel wey dey before am.

For im days Hiel from Bethel build Jericho. E lay im foundation with di loss of Abiram im firstborn, and set up im gates with di loss of im youngest pikin Segub, as di word of di Lord wey e talk by Joshua, Nun pikin.

Elijah from Tishbe, wey be one of di strangers wey dey stay for Gilead, talk to Ahab say, “As di Lord, di God of Israel, dey alive, wey I dey stand before, dew or rain no go dey for dis years, except by my word.”
Di word of di Lord come to am say,
“Go from here, turn toward east, and hide for Cherith stream, wey dey front of Jordan.
E go happen say you go drink from di stream, and I don command di ravens to feed you there.”
So e go and do as di word of di Lord talk, because e go stay by Cherith stream, wey dey front of Jordan.
Di ravens dey bring am bread and meat for morning, and bread and meat for evening, and e dey drink from di stream.
E happen after some time say di stream dry up, because rain no dey for di land.
Di word of di Lord come to am say,
“Stand up, go Zarephath, wey belong to Sidon, and stay there. Look, I don command one widow there to feed you.”
So e stand up and go Zarephath. As e reach di gate of di city, look, one widow dey there dey gather sticks. E call am and talk say, “Bring small water for cup make I drink.”
As e dey go bring am, e call am and talk say, “Bring small piece of bread for your hand come for me.”

E talk say, “As di Lord your God dey alive, I no get bread, only one handful of flour for jar and small oil for bottle. Look, I dey gather two sticks, so that I go enter go bake am for me and my pikin, so that we go eat am and die.”
Elijah talk to am say, “No fear. Go do as you talk, but first make small bread from am for me and bring am come, and after dat make some for you and your pikin.
Because dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: ‘Di jar of flour no go finish, and di bottle of oil no go dry, until di day wey di Lord go send rain on di earth.’”
E go and do as Elijah talk, and e, and Elijah, and im house chop plenty days.
Di jar of flour no finish, and di bottle of oil no dry, as di word of di Lord wey e talk by Elijah.
E happen after dis things say di pikin of di woman, di owner of di house, fall sick, and im sickness hard so tay breath no remain for am.
E talk to Elijah say, “Wetin me and you get to do, you man of God? You come to me to bring my sin come mind and to kill my pikin!”
E talk to am say, “Give me your pikin.” E carry am from im chest go up enter di room wia e dey stay, and put am for im own bed.
E cry to di Lord and talk say, “Di Lord my God, you don bring evil on di widow wey I dey stay with too, by killing im pikin?”
E stretch imself on di pikin three times and cry to di Lord say, “Di Lord my God, make dis pikin soul come back inside am.”
Di Lord listen to Elijah voice, and di pikin soul come back inside am, and e live again.
Elijah carry di pikin and bring am down from di room enter di house and give am to im mama, and Elijah talk say, “Look, your pikin dey alive.”
Di woman talk to Elijah say, “Now I know say you be man of God, and say di word of di Lord for your mouth na truth.”
